commands.speak: Set Instrument mode switch to DAY or Night or NVG as required!
Set Battery Master Switch to Engage and then On!
On master list, verify the green Power up test OK is in view!
Set Test Fire 1 to , EXT . Verify FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 USED caution is shown on master list !
Set Test Fire 1 to, EXT, plus Warn. Verify: Engine 1 Fire, FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 TEST mesages are shown on master list! On warning unit, verify FIRE, EXT, BOT 1, BOT 2 lights are on!
Set Test Fire 2 to , EXT. Verify FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 USED caution is shown on master list !
Set Test Fire 2 to , EXT, plus Warn. Verify: Fire Engine 2, FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 TEST mesages are shown on master list! On warning unit, verify FIRE, EXT, BOT 1, BOT 2 lights are on!
Set Test switch to LAMP and hold. Check all indicating lights and EXIT emergency lights are on!
Set Test switch to OFF, make sure all lights return to normal!
On the VMS display: push NUM, softkey, then push Weights and adjust values. Validate and push PREV,!
Verify DC voltage is more than 23.5 Volts, check fuel quantity!

On Master list, Verify ENG,1 FAIL ENG,2 and AFT plus forward Fuel Pump, EPU connected (if connected), Pitot1 heater off pitot 2, power up test ok, messages are displayed! Verify no rotor brake message is in view!
On IESI wait for alignment, then, On MFD and IESI set baro as required!
On cyclic and collective, push and hold trim release! Move flight controls throughout full travel, check for free movement!

normstartupckl.speak: Set anticollision light as required. Note that must be on for engine starting!

commands.speak: Set fuel prime pumps 1 and 2 ON!
If fire guard is present, post him!
Make sure rotor area is clear!
FND master list: acknowledge messages!

then.speak: Set Engine 1 or 2 main switch to IDLE and start clock!
Set other Engine main switch to IDLE

commands.speak: Monitor N1, T O T, N2, Nr parameters increase!
Check engine oil, MGB oil and hydraulic pressures increase!

then.speak: On master list: check green STARTUP TST OK message is displayed!

else.speak: FND master list: check STARTUP TST message is displayed!

then.speak: On master list and VMS: At 60% of N1 verify STARTER ON message is extinguished!
On master list and VMS: At 60% of N1 verify STARTER ON message is extinguished!

commands.speak: At about 78% of Nr, in idle, verify N2 and Nr are matched!
Verify no system related caution indication is present!

commands.speak: Set TEST HYD switch to SYS1 and hold. Check for LOW PRESS HYD2 on master list and amber HYD2 P on VMS !
Press and hold Cyclic trim release !
Perform small cyclic movements and verify longitudinal and lateral motion !
Perform small  pedals movements and raise collective from 0 to 1 FLI and verify normal forces are required !
Set TEST HYD switch to SYS2 and hold. Check for LOW PRESS HYD1 and HYD TR SHUT OFF on master list and amber HYD1 P on VMS !
Perform small cyclic movements and verify longitudinal and lateral motion !
Perform small pedals movements and raise collective from 0 to 1 FLI and verify normal forces are required !
release Cyclic trim release switch !
Set TEST HYD switch to OFF !

commands.speak: Instrument mode switch: Set DAY, Night or NVG as required!
Battery Master Switch: Set Engage then On!
Safety belts: Check fastened!
Pilot and copilot doors, verify position and properly latched!
FND Master list: Acknowledge ML and check POWER UP TEST OK!

startupckl.speak: Anticollision lights: set as required (for engine starting, set ON)!

commands.speak: Fuel prime pumps 1 and 2 switches ON!
If fire guard is present, post him!
Check rotor area clear!
Set both engines 1& 2 MAIN switches to IDLE, wait at least 1 second then set both switches to FLT!
On both Engines monitor N1,TOT,N2,NR parameters increase
Check engine oil, MGB oil and hydraulic oil positive indications!
FND Master list: Check STARTUP TEST OK Appears!
At approximately 60% of N1 verify, on master list, STARTER ON indication is not in view! On VMS No START indication is in view!
N2 and NR: Check in flight mode and matched!

set_dispatch.text: ML:FUEL1 PRIME PUMP ON FUEL2 extinguished
ML:FUEL1 PRIME PUMP ON FUEL2 extinguished
ML:FUEL1 PRIME PUMP ON FUEL2 extinguished
NOTE: Tests to be done before every IFR or, for VFR, at least once a day

commands.speak: Set STANDBY BAT and AVIO Master 1 and 2 Switches ON!
Set Pitot static heating Copilot and pilot switches to ON
Set LAVCS to Pil or Pax as required!
Set FUEL PRIME PUMP 1 and 2 switches to OFF! Verify on Master list: FUEL1 PRIME PUMP FUEL2 extinguished!
Set Fuel Transfer Pump Aft and Forward switches to ON! Verify on Master list: AFT+FWD FUEL PMP extinguished!
Set external position and strobe lights as required!
Set Internal Emergency Exit lights switch to ARM!
Verify Avionics, communication and navigation equipment are on as required
Set ventilation as required!
Unlatch collective and push fully down!
Set TEST switch to LAMP and hold. Check MKR Hi, DME1 HOLD, DME2 HOLD, FMS1 OFF and FMS2 OFF lights are on!
Set TEST switch to P-FLT (hold briefly)
Verify preflight test is running, wait for P-FLT TEST OK indication on Master list!
Engage AP1 and AP2 from cyclic or APCP!
On FND AFCS strip verify 3 green rectangles are displayed for 10 seconds!
Press AP/BKUP CUT switch on cyclic and check AP1 and 2 OFF indications are lighted on APCP. On FND check amber SAS indication appears in 2 locations and AFCS DISENGAGED message is shown
Press AP/BKUP CUT switch again and check AP1 and 2 OFF indications are lighted on APCP. On FND check red SAS indication appears in 2 locations and AFCS DISENGAGED message is shown
Check Cyclic beep trim in all directions!
Center cyclic and set pedals parallel!
